cases.answer: Check the dashboard lights and listen for a single click, as this may indicate an issue with the ignition system or battery. If no immediate hazard is present, use the owner's manual to follow model-specific steps for immobilizer, key, jump-start, and other procedures. Observe whether the dash lights dim or go out during a controlled start attempt; if there’s no response after one try, stop and seek help. Do not keep cranking repeatedly—this can drain battery power and may lead to further damage.

cases.answer: Stop and mark the last known point as soon as landmarks, trail, or position stop matching expectations.
